study type: Retrospective analysis of prospectively collected clinical data combined with an animal model study (in mice).
cohort: The study included 23 women who experienced miscarriage before gestational week 21, 53 well-matched women with full-term pregnancies, and an animal model of mice.
finding: An HSP60/HSP70 ratio equal to or more than 6 until gestational week 12 is significantly associated with an increased likelihood of miscarriage, a finding mirrored in an animal model of pre-term delivery.
cross-section timing: Blood samples collected for prenatal screening, with the key ratio assessed until gestational week 12 for predicting miscarriage.
gest_age: Miscarriage before gestational week 21; HSP60/HSP70 ratio prediction until gestational week 12.
